title: Timer Workflows: Run Tasks on a Schedule | Orchard Core
description:
Some tasks have to run at set times: a reminder every Monday, a cleanup every night, a report every morning. A workflow normally waits for something to happen, so a task that depends on the clock needs the clock to be an event.

The Timer Event of the Orchard Core Workflows module is that event. It runs a workflow on a CRON schedule, or makes a running workflow wait until the next scheduled time. This video enables the timer, builds a scheduled workflow and follows its instances.

In this video:
• How a timer works, and the five fields of a CRON expression
• Enabling the Timer Workflows Activities feature
• Building a scheduled workflow with a Timer Event and a Log Task
• Watching the instances of a timer workflow
• Good to know: the one-minute check, restarts and housekeeping
